products.title: Star Vie Helion 2024 - Star Vie
products.description:
STAR VIE HELION 2024 - Look for maximum precision on the track with the new Helion model. High control racket, round in shape and medium-low balance to achieve a defense game of 10. INTRODUCTION OF THE RACKET

STAR VIE HELION 2024, is the name of this racket. A new 2024 season model, which is intended for a control-based game. Its round shape and good comfort make it an ideal option for an intermediate level player.

PLAYER TYPE

This padel racket is highly recommended for a medium level player who plays in the defense zone.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

We are going to analyze the characteristics of the STAR VIE HELION 2024, a padel racket designed to give you a perfect game from the defense zone, as it provides softness in hitting to increase control. It is made with Star Vie's Ultra Speed ​​Soft rubber, which is the softest rubber available in the brand.

Internally it has a hybrid composition in the tubular that combines carbon fiber and fiberglass. On the other hand, the planes are made of 100% fiberglass, but of different densities, which improves ball output and also durability.

It is a product 100% manufactured in Spain, specifically in the city of Guadalajara.

PLAY STYLE

If you are looking for a racket with which to dominate, this is one of the best padel rackets from the Spanish firm that you will be able to have. The STAR VIE HELION 2024 is a sure success in defense, also allowing a good attack.

products.title: Vibora Radical Black Yellow Padel Bag - Vibora
products.description:
VIBORA RADICAL BLACK YELLOW PADEL BAG - Spacious, elegant and high quality for an incredible product. The Vibora RAdical Black Yellow Padel Bag provides us with excellent ease and comfort to transport all our material for padel classes and matches. It is possible to carry it as a bag with small handles and as a backpack with the large padded ones.

In its central section we have good space for the most voluminous utensils, towels, balls, clothes... We find space for two paddles in each side pocket.

Finally, two very important spaces should be highlighted, a small area closed with a zipper to store a cell phone, wallet, etc. and another larger one in the lower area with ventilation to put our shoes in. For all this, we consider it an excellent choice for the player looking for a large padel racket bag with space for everything.

products.title: Siux Trilogy Elite 2026 - Siux
products.description:
SIUX TRILOGY ELITE 2026 - One of the Siux padel rackets with the most control. Elite version, manufactured in round format and 3K carbon fiber. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The SIUX TRILOGY ELITE 2026 is a round-shaped racket, with total control, a large sweet spot and a modern design that follows the aesthetics of its predecessors.

PLAYER TYPE

Are you a drive player looking for high control in your game? This model is recommended for players of any level, since it is a comfortable and versatile racket that can adapt to everything. It is a high-end model.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The SIUX TRILOGY ELITE 2026 is designed in a round format, with the charismatic mold of the Trilogy series that it brings every year. This shape is possibly the one that offers the best handling and sensations to the player.

3K carbon is present throughout its structure, that is, both in the frame and in the planes. It combines with the medium eva rubber, which has a pleasant touch and is very reactive.

We highlight the rough sandpaper effect surface that it incorporates, which together with the specific pattern of holes, makes it much easier for us to create hits with spin, in addition to increasing control.
